description:
Three hours tour planned to visit the main monuments and places of the historic city. Visit the Masterpieces of Classic, Renaissance and Baroque art (historical, religious, romantic) with the scenery of the day and the night spotlight in Rome. So I have a Vespa and I really like going by scooter to the center of Rome. Now in winter the temperature is a little cold and my suggestion to my guest is wearing welI. Iwould like to offer my Vespa to tourists who are passionate the day and night tour with the scooter at Rome . So I'm driver of my scooter(with the Italian driving license) and I offer to guests the experience -service like day and night tour-trip. The guests are who decide where they want to go;but I have suggestions for my guests visits, for example Coliseum, Circus Maximus, Venezia square, Nazionale street, Del Corso Street, Largo argentina, Villa Borghese, Castel sant'Angelo, Ponte Sant'Angelo, Lungo tevere, Trastevere, Ponte milvio, Olympic stadium, San Giovanni in laterano, and everywhere they want to visit by scooter In Rome.
Other things to note:
The meeting point can also be my guests' quarters or Hotel in Rome near the centre ( no more than 4 kilometers from the historic center). The service can also be like transporting people where the guest wants to go( not only a touristic trip, even small comercial-trips in Rome)
hostdescription:
Conosco Roma molto bene perché vivo qui a Roma da 12 anni, ho studiato all'università per le scienze del turismo e mi piacerebbe avvicinarmi al campo in cui ho studiato. Sto già lavorando con Airbnb piu di 3 anni, e direi che, sto facendo bene. Mi piace la musica, il cinema, visitare musei e leggere libri. Per lo sport, mi piace il calcio, il nuoto e la corsa.
Ho 39 anni e sono pronto per dare nuova esperienza-servizio ai miei ospiti con la mia Vespa.
locationDescription: For those who, while we discover on the city, even if my guest want something to eat (gastronomia romana) I have a suggestion the roman pizzeria for eating and drinking. Instead, for those who want to eat ice cream, I know good ice cream's store.

reviews.text: I couldn’t recommend this tour more. Seyed was so kind and genuinely wants his guest to have a good tour. Shows them every stop they want, went above and beyond and even refused my tip at the end when I insisted. Super great guy and a super great tour everyone support

Highly recommended!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The experience was perfect for a solo traveler like me and for someone who is traveling with limited time. We went to all important sites and things to see. Great conversation, very informative, safe driver and takes (Hidden by Airbnb) able photos!! It was amazing!!

Mohsen was very kind and I felt completely safe riding around Rome with him in his Vespa. He was very knowledgeable with information about the tourist attractions we stopped at and even took great photos.
Awesome experience. Seyed took me to places I never thought would have go and took all my pictures without any trouble! Will recommend him a thousand time. I got in love with Rome!

This experience was amazing value with a three hour ride and a some food and drink along the way.

I didn’t ask for any specific locations (other than not needing to see the colosseum again) so it was great to just go around on a Vespa. It also meant I could see a lot all over the city, which would normally have taken ages by public transport and you can pick where to go back by yourself if you want to go inside places or see more.

Lots of photos were offered - even one on the Vespa that made it look like I knew how to ride ;)

I’m a solo traveller so this was a great option for me!

Seyed not only was a safe and great Vespa guide, but he was also welcoming and extremely kind! He was patient when I wanted to stop and take pictures. He also happily took pictures of me, which was appreciated since I was a solo traveler! Seyed also took me to some great local places off the tourist circuit, which was really appreciated. It was a great tour, and because he had some free time, he spent some extra time with me free of charge. I TOTALLY recommend the night tour. Rest up before and do it! It was great to see Rome by night, and the touristy sites weren't very crowded. Follow his advice and wear a jacket!! It gets cool at night. Thanks, Seyed!!! It was really wonderful.

The tour with Seyed is amazing in every way. I highly recommend it, please do it, it is incredible to see the city from another point of view and Seyed is very friendly and tells you about interesting aspects of each place. Well worth it.

You won't find a better way to spend your time in Rome! I enjoyed every second of my tour with Mohsen. He was flexible, easy to connect with and courteous. An absolute gentleman for the solo female traveler. He gave me the gift of memories in Rome that I'll never forget! Thank you for going above and beyond to make my time in Rome absolutely perfect!

This was so much fun and absolutely worth the money! Rome on the back of a Vespa is pure gold! Sayed was very warm and friendly. We had a great conversation over lunch. He studied tourism in college and knows tons. It was some times hard to hear with the helmet on and his broken English. But I didn’t care. We covered so much ground and he stopped to take pictures if I wanted. Don’t hesitate to do this!

The best experience that I had in Rome by far! It was fun, exciting and beautiful to be touring around Rome on a vespa. Seyed is a careful driver and made sure we see all the major attractions of Rome as well as the hidden gems that only locals know about. Plus we ended our tour by having an awesome lunch and talking more about life in Italy. The entire trip was a delight and I highly recommend it to anyone who is a bit short on time and wants to experience the most they can in a day (which was exactly my case). Thank you Seyed for making sure I had the best time and that my trip to Italy leaves most exciting memories!! :)

It’s a must do when you’re in Rome and don’t have much time or wants to experience Vespa in Rome.

Seyed was very professional, knowledge with history and places. He took a lot of nice photos and we went to many places in such a short hours. I would do it again if I am in Rome. Thank you so so much Seyed!!
This was such a fun experience! We rode around the city and saw all the must-see spots in 2 hours and Seyed also took a lot of great pictures for me. Totally worth it!

Fantastic Tour! Highly Recommended. The Gelato was the best I have had so far! Great for Solo travelers. Very happy with the photos and the experience. Saw heaps of sites! Can’t rate this experience highly enough!

I went on the morning tour with Seyed on Sunday, Sept 8. I only had 2 full days in Rome so this was a fantastic way to get a private introductory tour of Rome in a short amount of time. As this was my first time seeing Rome, I asked to see the main attractions. During the ride, Seyed provided short explanations on not just the attractions but also key areas, streets and lesser known areas. He also took me to 2 beautiful spots where I got magnificent views of Rome and was my personal photographer. We stopped for snacks and wine and had great conversation on culture, movies, family, etc. Also, this was my first time on a Vespa but the ride was very smooth throughout. I definitely recommend this experience for first-timers to Rome.

Had a wonderful time with Seyed. He has amazing, easy going personality and really flexible. He asked me about my life and told me about his which gave me a different perspective of life in Rome. Take his tour, it will definitely be the highlight of your trip! He also takes amazing pictures!
This is a very unique way to get to know Rome quickly, and it's like your friend showing you around. A great idea especially if you have time to be by yourself.

This tour was a really good means of discovering Rome. Would highly recommend it especially if you’re staying in Rome for a short period of time and want to tour the city!
Seyed is also a really knowledgeable host!

Seyed is a phenomenal host who goes out of his way to customize the tour to your whims, improvising along the way and safely taking you to many places that would be challenging on foot (especially if yours were already hurting like mine from all the walking!) When it started raining he found a phenomenal place with covering, so he could explain the history and we could have a view as the storm passed. It actually added to the neat ambiance! He also took many photos which is nice as a solo traveler and on a one-on-one your. His warmth and knowledge is one-of-a-kind, and the scooter experience in Rome is a must for an authentic, liberating one! 110% value for the cost! Mille grazie, Seyed !

Great concept, and this type of tour was perfect for us. We didn’t have a lot of time in Rome, but we wanted to see Rome at night and see spots we wouldn’t normally go to.

I booked him for both blocks. My 18 year old son loved it. He went first, then I went second. My son was able to ask questions, get simple answers and he was able to customize his tour. I was able to spend time in areas that were off the beaten path. Seriously way worth the $$$. Book him asap.
This was a really fun way to see Rome at night. I got to see way more then I thought I would in a couple hours. The flexibility and openness is awesome. Must try in my book.
Seyed made sure I enjoyed the tour. He is very knowledgeable, and was sure to ask where I have other tours so we only visit sights once. The tour includes very good quality food stops as well!

The time with Seyed and his vespa was really good. He picked me up from near my home and we had a good ride in his Vespa covering multiple places as promised. Showed some unique non touristy spots as well as took me to a authentic pizzeria. We connected really well and I left the tour with satisfaction and a sense of friendship.

Great way to discover Rome. I took the advice of the other reviews and booked for my first night in Rome and it was a very good idea.
Seyed Mohsen is attentive, adapts to your wishes. + Even though I'm not used to driving on 2 wheels at all, I felt safe throughout the visit thanks to controlled driving.
In short, I would recommend it without hesitation!

If you only have a few days in Rome this is the best thing to do! Seyed brought me to all the places I wanted to see and also a few I would’ve have thought of/known about. He was so kind, flexible and fun! Would definitely recommend to a friend.

I can’t recommend this experience enough!! If you want want a great way to see Rome in a few hours - this is it! He made me feel comfortable and safe and took many photos! He knew all about the history and it really made for a great experience. Also, the gelato was amazing.

This is an absolutely unbelievable experience ! Not only do you get to see many sites of Rome in the span of a few hours, but you also are able to hear about the history of each of those places from Seyed. To add to the magic, it's all done on the back of a Vespa, so you truly feel like you are doing as the Romans do. Seyed is so nice and caring and takes pictures of you at each of the sites. I cannot recommend this experience enough !!!!! Amazing 😁😁😁

My evening with Seyed was wonderful! He makes you feel safe and comfortable from the start. You get to see many different areas and he gives you information about each place! He will meet you and drop you off, which I found to be incredibly helpful. He also took some incredible pictures of me and was quite the photographer! :) We had some of the best gelato I’ve ever had during the experience as well. Thank you Seyed, it was an evening I’ll always remember. If you’re debating on doing this... DO IT!

I noted on the vespa ride last minute when sourcing for short duration activity before heading Firenze the next day.
It was a risk for me as normally i must do my details research before taking upon.

I had requested to meet at airbnb via Manin and seyed agreed so. It was convenient for me as i arrived (frm Kul) 13:25 & 15:30 ride. I had also requested (if time permits) to explore Jewish ghetto n sunset Colosseo.

We met on time. I was debrief on the ride n he explained with simplicity. Safety comes first, the helmet! We went to Fontana di Trevi, Piazza Reppublica, Via Nazionale, Piazza Venezia, the ghetto (yes!!), the sinagoga and many more. İ have enjoyed it very much as i understand why it is as it is because what it had been at least 500 years back. The cobblestone narrow streets, the gates, the steps at Foro İmperiale, the historic storyline was light hearted. it was great experience. i had enjoyed Tiberina island, the mystic behind the name n music too.

We closed the ride w sunset at Colosseo - majestic place with hidden sadness of inhumanity back then. A show of power, a struggle of slavery, and the remarkable reminder of humanity.

The vespa ride has been a unique experience n the host had made it memorable. Keep up the good job. improve further.

I did this on my first day and it was such a good way to see everything Rome had to offer! Seyed explained the history and even offered to take photos at every stop. This was something I've always wanted to do and it was such a great experience. Definitely recommend!

This was an amazing experience with Seyed, to be on a Vespa in Rome is so special and fun, plus he brings you to the most famous monuments and explains their history and importance, including a nice lunch in a Roman place in which we tried an amazing Roman pizza and white wine, This is a must if you like motorbike and tours combined.

This was one of my favorite experiences in Italy! (And I did a big handful of them through AirBnB, too.) It was so fun on a scooter and with Seyed since he's a professional! I think it was especially fun and thoughtful because it was a one-on-one tour and he's very knowledgeable, kind and experienced. Highly recommend!

This experience is a great way to see Rome. Seyed lets you choose where to go and takes a lot of good pictures of you while you’re at the tourist attractions. The experience lasted for over 3 hours, so it was more than expected. I really enjoyed the gelato at the end of the trip. Grazie!

The motorbike ride was fun, and a different way to see Rome. I liked having the individual time to go see the popular places without having to walk in the heat! Sayed was a gentleman, polite and attentive, willing to share his knowledge of Rome. But mostly this was an exciting way to end my trip to Rome.

Seyed is amazing!!!!! I highly recommend this experience. It was my first time in Rome and he took me to some wonderful places and even took some amazing pictures for me! I would definitely do it again! He is a very nice person and has a lot of knowledge about Rome and is able to explain history and background of all the places. He’s also very flexible with time and places you wish to visit. I LOVED IT!

Its a must have experience, its an excellent and fast way to know the important places, Sayed was very thoughtful and wqs taking pictures and telling me stories and the pizza near the finale was delicious, he also drop me qhere i had to be after this experience, this is a must do!

If you are in Rome for 1 day or for 100, PLEASE book it! Seyed’s scooter tour is just PHENOMENAL! He was on time, he took me to the most exciting places in Rome and made sure to take good pictures of myself in ALL of them! We did have an amazing gelatto and he even brought a couple of bottles of water with him since it’s summertime and it was around 90°F/30°C, very considerate of him! I did search for so many experiences and booked with Seyed last minute and I honestly couldn’t have picked anything better! Wether you’re alone or friends in home, book the tour! You won’t regret! Thank you very much, Seyed!

I had an amazing time with Seyed. My favorite experience of all of the things I did in Rome. I felt so comfortable with him. He let me do and go wherever I wanted. We pretty much saw all of Rome in one night. He bought me gelato and made sure I was taken care of. The experience says 2.5 hours but it lasted for almost 4! Would 100% recommend, very unique and great experience.
Really Great And beyond the experience is that friendship you made , lovely person we really Connected and expert for what he show , thank you so much seyed and ride safe 🙏🏻
A fantastic experience! The best way to see Rome. Seyed was the perfect tour guide - a very safe driver, kind, considerate, knowledgeable and a lovely guy!

A unique experience without a doubt!! Seyed is very kind and very attentive, I loved the tour💕, he certainly knows the place perfectly and knows what he does, even though I spoke Spanish he understood me perfectly and I have no words to do it justice, he is a very good and special person, I would definitely cheer him again as a guide 👌🏼👌🏼👌🏼 by the way if you go to the Trevi fountain try the ice cream that is nearby 🤤🤤 a wonder

it was really great) very interesting and comfortable.the perfect way to see everything in short time and to know the history of the places and even have nice photos.
My best recommendation)

What a fantastic tour. An experience I will always remember. Seyed was very knowledgeable and friendly - it was like travelling with an old friend. I would sincerely recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see Rome in a somewhat different way.

After 13 days of traveling all over Italy, this was the highlight of my trip! I saw everything I wanted plus some, had the best gelato, water, information; and felt safe and connected! I’m so glad I decided to take this tour!

It's a must've given experience for Rome! What can be more fun than roaming around Rome and seeing beautiful sights on a Vespa?
Seyed is such an amazing person and host. He's so nice and friendly. He'll make you feel welcomed and focuses on you and what you want to do (rather than what he wants you to do) which adds the personal touch to it! He knows a great deal of history and has good insights as well.
What's more? He's an amazing conversationalist as well!
Would recommend this for everyone 😊
Wonderful! Seyed was so kind and even brought me me to his friends shop to try freshly cut prosciutto! Customized tour with someone who is an expert, what a DREAM:)

Must go! Go in the beginning of your trip and get a solid base understanding of the area. Seyed is very friendly and very well versed in all the history of Rome and the major sites. You cannot find a better value tour. Doing it at night is perfect No crowds and less heat! He works in the city also so he will also show you some great local spots! He has a great passion for the city, and makes you feel like you are family member. He really worked with me even though I was late for my booking and he was so nice and understanding.

Unforgettable trip experience! I was only in Rome for one day and needed to spend a whole day, I chose a night tour and got a lot of positive emotions. Said didn't look at the time, it was important for him to show me Rome and do my best to make sure I see absolutely all the beauty of this city!

Seyed really made my last night in Rome very special! He showed me a different side of Rome where the locals gathered. I have always wanted to go on a Vespa in Rome and it was amazing - such a perfect way to travel. Seyed was so nice and he made the tour very customised which was amazing! He should definitely charge a little bit more, but thank you for a wonderful experience. Definitely perfect for solo travellers

The Vespa ride was cut short due to some unexpected situation but Seyed was super supportive and I appreciated his concern very much. I loved the feeling of being on a vespa in Rome. IT WAS AMAZING. I have to say though that maybe he can record an audio that he gives to the person who rides his vespa for the tour because it was repeated more than once that he would point at a spot while driving the vespa and that led us to swerve a little bit on the street which honestly scared me alot. But other than that, I wish I have the chance again to explore rome on a vespa. And seyed is a very kind and decent man.

What an incredible experience!! It has always been a dream of mine to do a Vespa tour in Italy so I was really happy when I found it on airbnb :D Mohsen is very friendly and easy-going and even though I had already been in Rome for a couple of days prior to the tour he managed to show me a lot of places that I haven’t seen before. It was very interesting to hear all of his knowledge about the monuments and Rome in general, the tour itself was also very customised, he always asked me what I would prefer to do which was very considered and overall awesome. It really was the perfect way to end my stay in Rome, what a great memory. Thank you again for everything, Mohsen! :)

So glad that I found this experience! I had such a great time with Seyed, he’s a genuinely sweet host that cares about the experience of his guests. We hit all the most important historic monuments, had delicious gelato and I’ve learned so much more about the beautiful history of Rome! Would definitely recommend this experience to others

This tour is a MUST for solo travelers or anyone who wants to see and learn about the most beautiful and historic places in Rome. A Vespa is the perfect way to travel and Seyed is the perfect guide. He will craft a route just for you based on your interests. 11/10 amazing value and a truly unique experience.

Seyed is incredible, he is very friendly and we immediately started chatting, he was very patient and professional; at all times he made sure that the tour was out of my liking, before starting he asks you if you require or want to do something in particular or opt for what he has already prepared, he knows the city and the main points of interest very well, in addition to taking the tour at night and that made it much better for the lighting, and improving the traffic.
A interesting tour, loved being on the Vespa and seeing Rome from a new and unique perspective. Memorable trip and made better by some delicious gelato!

Amazing and unique experience. What a truly special night with Seyed. Even if you are not into history this tour is a must. I do love historical stories but the best things is the host really. He takes such care of you during the whole experience. He takes good picture and he is really attentive to your need. He even help me find my way back home

Amazing I highly suggest. I wish I knew how to put a picture in the comments...

Seyed was the perfect guide. ☺️ He was so welcoming, caring and there is no better vespa driver all over Rome. I always felt safe when we were driving.
He showed me around to the most famous monuments and explained everything. Seyed went to have lunch with me in a very good restaurant and showed me the best roman food. I was so happy to choose the tour with Seyed I can warmly recommend this tour... 🍀☀️
I'm extremely happy, it was a wonderful experience and Sayed is an excellent human being. I think it made my visit to Rome special, I would do it again a thousand times... highly recommended ;)

This was such a fun experience to do in Rome. I have always wanted to ride on a motorbike. It was nice doing this with an experienced driver as well. The host was very nice and helped you know where to meet. I really enjoyed my time on the motorbike. If you are looking for a way to get around the city and find out where the monuments are then I recommend this experience.

Seyed is a great chap. I agree with the other comment that he could/should charge more for this experience.
I had a really great time going about a bunch of places of interest in Rome with Seyed on his Vespa. I absolutely recommend this experience to anyone who's visiting Rome, preferably towards the start of their trip so that they can get a sense of what the city's like and what they'd like to do for the rest of their trip.

What a wonderful, smart and insightful man, my initial plan was to go on the hop on and off bus but I decided to take his bike instead. I think it was value for money . He could charge a bit more . I’ve seen Rome in more ways then any other person who was on the bus could have.
Was a beauty experience to share time with Seyed in his scooter and know more places of the eternal city of Rome!!! Thank you!!!

Seyed is a gem of a guy. To me it felt like one to one/personal tour. I could go to all tourists attraction in two hours or just be at one place and enjoy that. I never felt rushed.

Seyed volunteered to take my pictures shows me local places to eat and even dropped me back at my accommodation. He also provided general advice about Rome and how things work locally. He was very contentious of my safety while riding his Vespa through jam packed Roman streets.

I would highly recommend this tour/experience. There is no other tour like this anywhere in Rome.

Thanks again Seyed.
She is a friendly and unique person. I had a great time and I met unique places
Honestly such a great experience. Such a Great way to see Rome. Highly recommend!!
Fun experience, with a genuinely kind guide. I would definitely recommend this tour.
It's a very interesting experience, with a small price. I highly recommend if you want to experience Rome differently.
Great experience, Highly recommended!
